name: Pokémon Short Films Collection
overview:
Pikachu shorts are Pokémon the Series-related shorts that almost exclusively feature Pokémon and chronicle miscellaneous adventures of Ash's Pikachu.

The bonus mini-movies (Japanese: 同時上映 simultaneous screenings), which are shorts that aired theatrically together with a corresponding movie in Japan: PK01 with M01, PK04 with M02, PK07 with M03, PK10 with M04, PK11 with M05, PK12 with M06, PK24 with M15, PK25 with M16, PK26 with M17, and PK27 with M18. The first six shorts are occasionally included on home video releases with their corresponding movies. With the exception of PK07, they were available on Netflix in Japan under the title Pokémon: Short Films Collection (Japanese: ポケモン映画 ショートフィルム・コレクション Pokémon Movie Short Films Collection).
